entities.summary: Andrei Viktorovich Nazarov is a Russian former professional ice hockey player and head coach of HC Sochi of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He has formerly managed the Kazakh team Barys Astana, the Ukrainian national team and has been joint coach of the Russian national hockey team. He has been nicknamed "the Russian Bear", and in his coaching career, "the Russian Keenan".
